name: Inventory failure
description: 3 USB-C docks when only 2 are in stock.
expect: Fulfillment cannot reserve (only 2 docks) and fails its task with INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE; the Operations Manager cancels the order with the shortage as the reason. If Accounting already registered the payment, OrderCancelled carries a refund due and the accountant refunds 540.00 (within accounting authority).
